metadata.description: Posty plugins: the MCP connector for chat, and the CLI for coding agents.

plugins.name: posty
plugins.description: Posty for chat: connect Claude to Posty's MCP server and schedule or publish social posts to Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord and Slack from the conversation. Browser sign-in, no key.

plugins.name: posty-cli
plugins.description: Posty CLI for coding agents: the posty command line tool and its full reference, for scheduling and publishing social posts from a terminal, a script or an agent with a shell (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes).
